{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dorumaa Business Improvement Association''' was an organization that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[For Every Action: Preemptive Strike|Preemptive Strike]]'', if the player characters succeed in recovering any money from [[Riboga's asteroid base]], the Improvement Association gives them 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as a reward.
